question.worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a product $u(x)\cdot v(x)$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{sin}⁡x$ and $v(x)=\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x.$

Therefore, we apply the product rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ={u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)+u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x) \\  & ={(\operatorname{sin}⁡x)}^{′}\cdot \operatorname{arcsch}⁡x+\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot {(\operatorname{arcsch}⁡x)}^{′} \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot \operatorname{arcsch}⁡x\,+\,\operatorname{sin}⁡x\cdot (-\frac{1}{|x|\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}) \\  & =\operatorname{cos}⁡x\cdot \operatorname{arcsch}⁡x-\frac{1}{|x|}\cdot \frac{\operatorname{sin}⁡x}{\sqrt{1+{x}^{2}}}.\end{aligned}
$$
